mapper.select: SELECT CAST(layout AS text) FROM platform_navigation_layout WHERE NOT deleted
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO platform_navigation_layout (id, layout, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, CAST(#{layout} AS jsonb), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor})
mapper.update: UPDATE platform_navigation_layout SET deleted = true, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE NOT deleted
